structuredContent.name: parties.search-parties
structuredContent.description: Search visible display names in the envelope tenant using trimmed, case-insensitive, diacritic-normalized exact, prefix, contains and fuzzy matching. Type and Active apply before paging; totals exclude erased parties. Empty query returns no matches. Date filters and advanced search modes reject. Use envelope paging: default size 20 and offset 0, maximum size 100, page-aligned offsets or a scoped continuation cursor. To continue, supply the returned paging.nextCursor without offset, keeping the same query, filters, envelope tenant, user and page size.

Query.description: Display-name query, at most 512 UTF-16 units including whitespace before trimming. Oversized input rejects; empty or whitespace returns no matches. Contact channels and business identifiers are not searched.

Type.description: Optional party kind: Person or Organization; Unknown and other values reject. Applied before paging.

Active.description: Optional active-status filter, applied before paging; omitted includes active and inactive parties.
